{
  "verdict": "SCAM",
  "risk_score": 95,
  "confidence": "HIGH",
  "scam_type": "Bank Impersonation KYC Scam",
  "injection_attempt_detected": false,
  "extracted_text": "Dear Customer, your SBI account has been temporarily blocked due to incomplete KYC. Update within 24 hours or it will be permanently closed: http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz/verify",
  "red_flags": [
    {
      "phrase": "temporarily blocked due to incomplete KYC",
      "tag": "IMPERSONATION",
      "why": "Fake bank warning designed to create panic."
    },
    {
      "phrase": "Update within 24 hours or it will be permanently closed",
      "tag": "URGENCY",
      "why": "False time limit to make you act quickly without thinking."
    },
    {
      "phrase": "http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz/verify",
      "tag": "SUSPICIOUS_LINK",
      "why": "Fake web address that does not belong to SBI."
    }
  ],
  "explanation": "This message is a fake. Scammers sent this to scare you into thinking your bank account is blocked. Real banks never send weird website links to update your details. If you click that link, they can steal your bank password or money.",
  "next_steps": [
    "Do not click the link or reply to the message.",
    "Never share your bank details, OTP, or passwords with anyone.",
    "Open your official banking app or check your account by typing the real website yourself.",
    "Block and report the number that sent this message.",
    "If you lost money, call 1930 immediately or visit cybercrime.gov.in."
  ],
  "share_message": "Be careful of text messages claiming your bank account is blocked. Real banks never send website links to fix your KYC. Do not click on any links."
}
